properties.description: A dependency that is itself a reflow2 design can say so, and one that is not stays silent (crates/reflow2-core/tests/depends.rs, 2 cases added, 12 passing in the file). LINKED: graph_id round-trips through the store and appears in reflow2.toml as `graph_id = \"dynograph-foundation\"`. UNLINKED, which is the case that carries the doctrine: a second declaration without one round-trips as None AND its manifest entry contains no graph_id line at all — absence is stored as absence, so a reader can tell \"this dependency has no reflow2 design\" from \"nobody recorded whether it does\". BLANK IS NOT A VALUE: a whitespace-only graph_id is treated as unstated rather than as a design whose id happens to be blank.
properties.findings: A TEST-AUTHORING SLIP WORTH KEEPING: the first version of the blank case asserted the whole manifest contained no \"graph_id =\", which passed for the wrong reason and then failed for the right one — the [reflow2] header always emits the design's OWN graph_id, so the assertion had to be scoped to the dependency entry. The test caught the test.
properties.name: A dependency that is itself a reflow2 design can say so, and one that is not stays silent
